InstitutionFacilityCsvDAO

class InstitutionFacilityCsvDAO[source]

Bases: DAO[InstitutionFacility]

DAO for InstitutionFacility entities, one CSV file per record.

Persists each institution facility in its own CSV file named after its ID and sanitized name, and keeps all institution facilities in an in-memory cache loaded when the DAO is created.

Attributes:
csv_handlerCSVHandler

Utility for reading and writing CSV data.

institutionfacilitiesdict[int, InstitutionFacility]

In-memory cache by ID.

file_mapdict[int, str]

CSV file path by ID.

int_propertieslist[str]

Names of the InstitutionFacility fields typed int.

bool_propertieslist[str]

Names of the InstitutionFacility fields typed bool.

Notes

Files are named <id>_<sanitized name>_institutionfacility.csv and stored in the institution facility directory of PathConfig.

generate_next_id()[source]

Return the next available institution facility ID.

Returns:
int

The highest cached ID plus 1, or 1 if the cache is empty.

write_with_lock(filepath, data, headers)[source]

Write rows to a CSV file while holding an exclusive lock.

Parameters:
filepathstr

Full path to the target CSV file.

datalist[dict]

Rows to write, one dictionary per row.

headerslist[str]

Ordered column names; a header row is written first.

Raises:
portalocker.exceptions.LockException

If the lock cannot be acquired within 10 seconds.

Notes

The user directories are created if needed. The file is opened by portalocker.Lock in mode "w" with Python’s defaults, so it uses the platform’s default encoding and newline translation, unlike CSVHandler.write_csv with a path (UTF-8 with BOM).

>>> dao = object.__new__(InstitutionFacilityCsvDAO)
>>> dao.sanitize_filename(" Ana Maria! ")

load_all_institutionfacilities()[source]

Load every institution facility CSV file into the cache.

Notes

Reads each *_institutionfacility.csv file of the institution facility directory; empty or unreadable files are skipped. Only the first row is used. Integer fields that are not plain digits (including negative numbers) become 0, and boolean fields are True only for "true" (any case).
